kind: registered technical/design comparison, not human A/B
tasks: own bedroom with ten valid furniture pieces
walk with chat moved and resize
draw/sticky/text/image paste with peer and saved return

comparisons.hold: same avatar/collision radii and furniture footprints; evaluate geometry independent of zoom
comparisons.measure: reachable targets, valid saved arrangements, usable circulation

comparisons.hold: matched supplied viewport/HUD/self path and room bounds for pure rig controls
comparisons.measure: HUD-change continuity, offscreen loss, overview retained, pan/zoom/recenter and reduced motion

comparisons.hold: same user tasks/identities and course viewports
comparisons.measure: actual task completion, focus/draft ownership, readable long content and reachable controls
comparisons.limit: multiple presentation factors change; not single-factor causal efficacy A/B

comparisons.factor: element merge vs scene replacement negative control
comparisons.measure: unrelated peer objects retained, deterministic convergence and durable retry

stop: Each declared task has actual source-bound verification; actionable independent findings repaired and affected checks pass. Do not repeat green runs for technique counts.
humanPreference: NOT RUN; owner feedback is qualitative baseline observation; no sampled user A/B winner
